subject.title: chore(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: Should an approved workflow/security owner accept these 14 new third-party GitHub Action SHAs for the privileged CI, release, scanning, and agent workflows?
rationale: The patch is mechanically limited to immutable action pins, but it changes code executed with credentials and release authority; that supply-chain trust decision cannot be resolved from tests or Dependabot metadata alone.

options.title: Approve verified revisions
options.body: Independently verify the pinned action releases and approve the batch, then refresh the merge candidate and require its applicable gates.

options.title: Split sensitive actions
options.body: Land only revisions approved for lower-privilege workflows and hold token, release, CodeQL, or Codex-action updates for separate owner review.

options.title: Pause the batch
options.body: Leave the PR open until an owner can verify the upstream revisions and their compatibility with the privileged workflows.

recommendation.title: Approve verified revisions
recommendation.body: Independently verify the pinned action releases and approve the batch, then refresh the merge candidate and require its applicable gates.

likelyOwner.reason: No individual workflow or security owner can be identified from the supplied context without guessing.
